answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 23634 Country: United Kingdom Title: sir nhtis is mehboob from u.k. b4 some days Istem of preston(sunni .rizvi) and imam of noorul-islaqm of bolton masjkid says that in namaj ,in rukoo instead of subahna-rabbial azim ucan say subahana -rabbiya karim. is it jayiz nad correct? pls urgently answer, Question: urgent.... salam-alayakum,,,, sir nhtis is mehboob from u.k. b4 some days Istem of preston(sunni .rizvi) and imam of noorul-islaqm of bolton masjkid says that in namaj ,in rukoo instead of subahna-rabbial azim ucan say subahana -rabbiya karim. is it jayiz nad correct? pls urgently answer, Answer ID: 23634 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1084/813/L=1431) It is mentioned in hadith that one should recite سبحان ربى العظيم. It is against hadith to recite سبحان ربى الكريم it should not be done without a valid reason. However if someone is unable to pronounce ظاء and recites سبحان ربى الكريم in place of سبحان ربى العظيم it is allowed for him. However he should keep on trying to pronounce ظاء. السنة فى تسبيح الركوع سبحان ربى العظيم الا إن كان لا يحسن الظاء فيبدل به الكريم لئلا يجرى على لسانه العزيم فتفسد به الصلاة كذا فى شرح در البحار فليحفظ فإن العامة عنه غافلون حيث ياتون بدل الظائ بزائ مفخمة (شامى : 2/198 باب صفة الصلاة) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
